creator: tldw-project
method: OpenAI built-in image generation from the user-requested animal concept and a textual description of the viewed collection style; user-authorized local alpha cleanup, proportional scaling, frame extraction and registration. The prepared idle bicycle base and lower body were reused across all sixteen poses to remove wheel and pedal drift.
reference_use: Existing collection artwork was inspected to describe its style. No existing Buddy image pixels are included in this new atlas.
